item.title: 【Albums (lossless)】AIFF - Melanie Martinez - HADES [ProStudioMasters Hi-Res PCM 24-Bit/48.0 kHz]
item.description:
Editor's Notes

Following the release of POSSESSION, her first new music in three years, Melanie Martinez officially releases her fourth studio album HADES. True to form, the multi-platinum, multi-hyphenate phenomenon doesn’t merely write songs—she builds worlds with unwavering intention. This era unfolds as a dystopian, cinematic landscape that feels uncomfortably familiar, less fantasy and more a fractured mirror of the present moment. “Each song on this record explores a different trap set by the kind of evil, patriarchal energy that is HADES. It isn’t about predicting a dystopian future. It’s about recognizing destructive patterns that already exist. The same dynamics repeating in different places. Control disguised as protection. Cruelty framed as logic. Exploitation sold as opportunity. Once you start noticing those threads, it becomes hard to ignore them.” - Melanie Martinez
